name: Exa
description: Neural web search for agent grounding: search the live web, fetch the cleaned full text of specific URLs Exa already indexed, and find pages similar to a given URL. Every call here is a POST but none of them mutate anything server-side, so all three are modelled write:false; this connector has no billable generation endpoint to gate.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Run a neural web search and return ranked results with title, url, publish date and a relevance score. A non-mutating POST, so write:false; this is also the spec's auth-proving test call

tools.name: get_contents
tools.description: Fetch the cleaned full text of specific URLs (get the URLs from search results). A non-mutating POST, write:false

urls.description: URLs to fetch content for, from search results

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find pages similar to a given URL, ranked by relevance. A non-mutating POST, write:false

url.description: URL to find similar pages for

needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real Exa api_key; a live /search costs roughly $0.005/call, trivial against the $20 signup credit.

Exa has no cheap authed GET for account balance, so the vault type's testEndpoint is null and validateCredentials checks key length only (format-only test depth); this spec's own /search POST carries the real auth proof.
